title: Session history graph
description: A content snapshot is not a commit. Full verify hashes the working tree; a later commit on that same tree binds without overwriting other history locations. The agent lab proves the chain with a real CLI, a mocked model, and the commit gate.

stations.title: Snapshot and commit stay distinct
stations.description: The graph assembler keeps a pending snapshot separate from a commit, and two commits can share one content snapshot.

stations.title: Real session, verify, commit, bind
stations.description: A real Claude Code turn against a mocked model, then full verify and commit, produces a commit binding whose tree matches the snapshot.
